name: mobile-screens
rationale: Phases 4-15 touch DIFFERENT page files and have objective, machine-checkable acceptance (the mobile viewport gate). Dependencies are absent, so a sequential chain would serialise work for no benefit and an orchestrator would add a planner that has nothing left to plan. Parallel fan-out is the smallest pattern that satisfies the requirement.

shared_constraint.problem: Every mobile task is tempted to edit the shared mobile system in src/web/layout.ts. Worktree isolation prevents working-copy collisions but NOT fan-in conflicts: four agents each adding a rule to the same @media block produces four conflicting diffs in the same hunk.
shared_constraint.resolution: The shared mobile system is FROZEN and owned by the integrator. Agents may only add page-scoped styles inside the file they own. An agent that believes it needs a shared-system change must report it as a finding instead of editing it.

tasks.goal: Replace desktop-derived campaign rows with objective-specific intelligence cards, and give campaign detail a progressive-disclosure order.

handoff_in.measured_baseline: campaigns: 4 controls <44px, 8 text nodes <12px, no overflow

handoff_out.dto_gaps: string[] — fields the UI needed that the DTO does not expose

tasks.goal: Five-step mobile flow (ID, request, waiting, approved, syncing) with no internal terminology exposed.

tasks.merge_reason: DESIGN CORRECTION, made during fan-out. The original config assigned these to src/web/pages/dashboard/sections/states.ts and filters.ts — neither file exists. Both bodies of work in fact live in dashboardPage.ts (3751 lines). Two agents owning one file is precisely the fan-in collision shared_constraint exists to prevent, so the parallel premise (independent subtasks) did not hold for this pair. Collapsed into one sequential agent rather than serialising a conflict at merge time.
tasks.goal: Phase 15: explicit LOADING / EMPTY / ERROR / PARTIAL / INSUFFICIENT_DATA / OFFLINE states, where INSUFFICIENT_DATA reads as 'still collecting', never 'no data'. Phases 9-11: filter bottom sheet, per-table card-vs-scroll decision with stated reasoning, chart legibility at 320px.

handoff_in.rule: Never invent a state the analytics layer does not report.
handoff_in.measured_baseline: no table currently exceeds the viewport; decide per table on user intent, not width alone

preconditions: node test_mobile_viewport.mjs passes (0 overflow, 0 page errors, all 6 widths)
analytics suites green: golden_archetypes, analytics_semantics, result_semantics, funnel_intelligence, intelligence, analytics_architecture
no_shared_css_edits: git diff must not touch the frozen @media block in src/web/layout.ts
no frontend analytics: test_analytics_architecture must still pass its PART B check
fan_in.on_precondition_fail: reject the branch, report the failing gate, do NOT merge partial work
fan_in.output: single integration branch + merged mobile report

budgets.context_policy: Each agent receives ONLY: its own page file, the audit findings for its route, the DTO contract it renders, and the mobile gate command. It does NOT receive the analytics workstream history — that is 6 phases of context irrelevant to rendering a card.

failure_policy.task_failure: isolate — a failed task does not block the other three; report it in the final summary

retry.only_when: gate failure is mechanical (tsc/overflow), not a design disagreement

failure_policy.partial_success: acceptable — merge the passing branches, report the rest as remaining work
